I used GIMP.

I took a stock picture of a goat and added a layer to it. with the path tool I traced the outline of the head and filled it with a dark-to-light brown gradient. I then went over it with brush Acrylic 03 with two different shades of brown.

I used a similar method for the horns, tho the left one is flat- and not gradient-filled.

I just cloned the eye and the mouth from the layer underneath.

I removed the original image and filled the layer with white.
